records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue increased 14% in the first quarter of 2022 primarily due to volume growth, yield improvement, and higher fuel surcharges across all of our transportation segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue at FedEx Express increased 14% in the first quarter of 2022 due to international export and U.S. domestic package volume growth, increased international and U.S. domestic package yield, and favorable exchange rates.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, higher self-insurance expenses primarily due to increased utilization of healthcare benefits postponed from 2021 due to the coronavirus (“COVID-19”) pandemic negatively impacted our first quarter 2022 results.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our results for the first quarter of 2022 reflect higher operating expenses related to labor market challenges that disrupted global supply chains.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, our net fuel position across all of our transportation segments positively impacted operating income in the first quarter of 2022.
